about: The field names of every message the labs pipeline passes between its three implementations: what the build writes into labs-dist/private, what the checkpoint API serves and takes, and what a notebook's client reads. Each of the three states these shapes in test material of its own — the frontend's built fixture, the backend's conftest, the client's fake server — and nothing but this file stops the three from drifting apart while all three suites stay green. A rename here is a rename in all of them.
